reasons.scrollable-region-focusable: The sample content of these stories is plain text, so the scrolling dialog body / panel body has nothing focusable. Real dialogs and panels hold controls; Chromium (130+) and Firefox make such scrollers keyboard-focusable, Safari does not. Decide in the overlay work whether ath-dialog / ath-panel set tabindex=0 while they overflow.
reasons.color-contrast: ath-nav-item project rows: the project key chip is decorative (aria-hidden; the label beside it names the row) and drawn at --deco-mix strength by design (app sidebar, ref 02 pastel keys), 2.3-2.6:1 at 9.5px. Moved as is from the app's nav item in quality step 2.3; a contrast-safe key colour is a token decision (U5), open for Joel.
